name: Monthly factor recommendation research v2
statement: Point-in-time monthly factor-sleeve evidence can rank the next month's net active return of official Top factor sleeves after declared sleeve costs and allocator costs.

pit_policy.membership: screen observation at or before feature_as_of_date
pit_policy.features: screen and platform context lagged by one complete monthly observation
pit_policy.execution: first trading day strictly after rebalance date; target weights applied after close return

asia_policy.currency_policy: no aggregate performance until common currency, PIT FX and common benchmark are proven

factor_definitions.name: value
factor_definitions.label: Value
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates cheaper valuation relative to the canonical cross-section.

factor_definitions.name: quality
factor_definitions.label: Quality
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates stronger canonical profitability, balance-sheet and earnings-quality characteristics.

factor_definitions.name: growth
factor_definitions.label: Growth
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates stronger canonical fundamental growth characteristics.

factor_definitions.name: momentum
factor_definitions.label: Momentum
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates stronger canonical price-momentum characteristics.

factor_definitions.name: lowvol
factor_definitions.label: Low Volatility
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates lower realized or canonical volatility characteristics.

factor_definitions.name: size
factor_definitions.label: Large Size
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates larger market-cap exposure; it is not a small-cap signal.

factor_definitions.name: small_size
factor_definitions.label: Small Size
factor_definitions.definition: The explicit inverse of Size: small_size = 100 - Size percentile.

factor_definitions.name: dividend
factor_definitions.label: Dividend
factor_definitions.definition: Higher percentile indicates stronger canonical dividend characteristics.

sleeve.research_unit: Date x Region x RegionComponent x Factor x SleeveSide

cost_assumptions.double_counting_policy: allocator cost is applied only to allocator turnover; official sleeve internal cost is not charged again

candidate_models.description: Equal valid-factor basket; no winner prediction.
